descriptions.notStarted: I have passed all the tests of #p2101002#. Maybe I'll be able to become a member of the Sand Bandits. I better talk to #p2101002#, the person I can trust the most on this.
descriptions.inProgress: #p2101002# told me the key to being a Sand Bandit is having a hatred toward the queen, but not letting it show, while biding time for the right moment to strike... and told me the most important aspect of being a Sand Bandit is patience. Patience... that's similar to refining ores. As Eleska told me, I better make #b2 #t4011008#s#k.   \n\n#i4011008# #t4011008#  #b#c4011008#/2
descriptions.completed: After receiving #t4011008#, #p2101002# told me with that level of patience, I deserve to be a member of the Sand Bandits, and she told me if I passed the test from other members, then I'll be able to join them. Other members? Come to think of it... the wall also stated bow and iron hammer.
